events.title: Demo v0.0.10634 — VÍBORA Gets a Special Move
events.summary: Demo update 0.0.10634: VÍBORA gets a special move "What's special about each snake?" came up a lot in your feedback. Here's the first answer. New: LUNGE VÍBORA now has a special move. Hit , click the mouse wheel, or pull LT on a controller, and your snake rockets forward straight through the horde. Nothing can touch you while you lunge, so it's your way out when the swarm closes in. Anything in your path takes a hit on the way. events.title: Demo v0.0.10152 — Linked Segments, Queued Levels and an Enemy Cap
events.summary: What's new Matching segments no longer merge into one: they link. Two matching segments side by side stay together, rank up together, and both remain in your body. The snake no longer shrinks when you fuse, so closing the Ouroboros is easier. Every body in the group fires at the group's tier. The MAW alternates: one body covers one flank and the next one covers the other. A support or a reaction that touches one body of the group reaches the whole group. events.title: Demo v0.0.9876 — The Story, 14 Scrolls and Levels With Their Own Rules
events.summary: The story A prelude before the first level. An old phone, a snake made of little squares biting its own tail, something tearing the loop open, and the fall into the Pit. Full length in SKILL MATCH; one line in ARCADE. 14 scrolls to recover. Every SKILL MATCH level you win, 1 to 6 plus hell, in both chapters, hands you a scroll. events.title: Demo v0.0.7110 — Patch Notes
events.summary: What's new: Demo v0.0.7110 The horde stops being one single bug. Every common enemy is now born with one of four strains: its own colour, mottling and blotches. Same species, different bodies. When eighty of them pile on top of you, you notice. The specials look special. The ALPHA, the ANCHOR and the PARASITE (Skill-Match, danger 2 and up) and the ELITES no longer announce themselves with just a ring.
